items.lede: Warhound came out of stealth on Wednesday with $200 million in funding and a mission to create “elite working dogs” equipped with "advanced body armor."
items.title: Palmer Luckey Made a Genetically Modified Military Dog Startup

items.lede: Warhound, the brainchild of Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, emerges from stealth to genetically engineer dogs for military and law enforcement.
items.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear

items.lede: Warhound is genetically engineering dogs for the military, law enforcement and first responder operations.
items.title: A startup called Warhound is genetically engineering dogs for the military

items.lede: A new Texas-based defense startup has a plan to improve military and police dogs in the US: it's going to genetically modify them and equip them with Anduril's military technology.
